transcript.text: Hello, this is Shreya calling from Mumbai Bank. Am I speaking to Rahul?
Yes, this is Rahul speaking. How can I help you today?
Thanks. I'm just calling about your Mumbai Bank credit card - the payment is due. By when are you planning to pay?
I was planning to pay soon, but I noticed there's a late fee on my account. Is there any way you could waive that fee? Other banks have waived late fees for me before.
Okay, a waiver request. I'm not allowed or trained to handle those, so I'll have a human support agent call you back. Thanks for your time, and have a good day.
